subject: Billing workflow and PO tracking for ACME (portal primary, email fallback)
messages:
From: Lisa Ortega <finance@acme-corp.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Invoice delivery preferences & PO requirement

Hi Rishi,

Quick question as we start the onboarding: what are our invoice delivery options with Redwood? Our AP team needs the PO number visible on/in the invoice and would prefer invoices to automatically land in our AP portal. If portal enrollment isn't available right away, email copies to finance@acme-corp.com are acceptable as a temporary fallback.

A few requirements from AP:
- PO number present as a discrete field and in the invoice subject/email header (so our parser can pick it up)
- VAT registration evidence attached if invoices are VAT-exempt or subject to reverse-charge
- Ability to include a ledger/project code (free text) in the invoice metadata

Attached is a sample PO for the first invoice (sample_po_88921.pdf). Can you confirm what you need from us to set up portal delivery and any format constraints (PDF vs XML/e-invoice)?

Thanks,
Lisa Ortega
Finance Manager, ACME Corporation
finance@acme-corp.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Ortega <finance@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 11:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery preferences & PO requirement

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear list and the PO. Happy to confirm options and proposed approach.

Short answer: we can make the portal the canonical delivery path and keep email as a 48-hour fallback. We can:
- Surface the PO number both in the invoice PDF (separate labeled field) and in the outgoing email subject as "PO: <number>" so your parser catches it.
- Include a free-text metadata field for ledger/project codes that our billing system will pass through as invoice metadata (visible in portal and in the invoice XML if you choose e-invoice).
- Attach VAT evidence if provided; we can also store your VAT certificate on file and mark subsequent invoices accordingly.

Format options: PDF (standard) or e-invoice XML (structured) — we recommend XML if you want automated ingestion into AP, otherwise PDF + metadata is a reliable combination.

Next steps I propose:
1) Please confirm the AP contact who should be the portal owner (we'll invite them).
2) Confirm whether you want XML or PDF for production.
3) Send a copy of your VAT cert (we'll attach it in our system).

If portal enrollment takes more than a week we'll enable email copies to finance@acme-corp.com with subject prefix "PO: <number>" and a secondary CC to ap_manager@acme-corp.com. Jordan and Kimberly — can you confirm we can add an "X-PO-Number" header and include the PO in invoice metadata on the outgoing webhook?

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Rishi / Kim — quick internal note on implementation constraints from the billing/runtime side.

- We can include a custom HTTP header X-PO-Number when we post invoices to customer webhooks; that will satisfy parsers that rely on headers.
- For portal-first deliveries, our webhook payload already includes an "invoice_metadata" map; we need a one-line spec from ACME for the key names they expect (e.g., ledger_code, project_id). If they prefer XML, we should namespace the ledger field to avoid collisions.
- Compliance flagged that for EU customers where reverse-charge applies, we must include a VAT_status field on the invoice PDF and in the payload (values: "Standard", "Reverse-charge", "Exempt"). We should store the supplied VAT cert and mark future invoices automatically.
- Fallback policy: set email fallback to trigger 48 hours after portal delivery if the portal response is empty or returns transient errors. Also include an SFTP push option for customers that cannot consume webhooks.

I can add the header and metadata keys today; we just need confirmation from ACME on the exact key names and file format preference.

—Jordan
Senior Integrations Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

Hi Lisa / Marco — looping back with a short implementation plan so we can get your first invoice out on the requested cadence.

Plan (agreed):
1) Portal primary: we'll invite Marco (ap_manager@acme-corp.com) as portal owner and enable automatic invoice drop. Portal supports PDF and XML; please confirm preference.
2) Metadata & PO handling: PO will be present in three places — (a) PDF labeled field, (b) email subject as "PO: <number>", and (c) X-PO-Number header / invoice_metadata.po_number for webhook/XML. That should cover parsers and manual review.
3) VAT evidence: please send your VAT cert to finance@redwood.example or upload to the portal. We'll attach it to your account (redwood_vat_certificate.pdf) and mark invoices with VAT_status = "Reverse-charge" where applicable.
4) Fallback & delivery SLA: portal attempt first; if we receive no acknowledgment or transient errors, we'll send an email copy to finance@acme-corp.com after 48 hours. We can enable an SFTP push instead of email if you prefer.

Action items for ACME:
- Confirm preferred invoice format (PDF / XML)
- Confirm portal owner: full name + email for invite (we plan to invite Marco Silva)
- Upload VAT cert or send it to finance@redwood.example
- Confirm ledger/project code key name if you want that carried as structured metadata (suggested key: ledger_code)

I'll attach a sample invoice PDF for formatting confirmation and our VAT cert on file.

Attachments: sample_invoice_202807.pdf (layout preview), redwood_vat_certificate.pdf (company VAT doc)

If that looks good I'll proceed with the portal invite today and set the fallback policy.
